problem.text: The change adds a qualitative long-context evaluation script covering summarization, passage identification, question answering and named-character extraction.

reasoning.text: Each task places the story before its instruction in a single user message. A Transformers tokenizer applies the chat template; the resulting token IDs become an ExLlamaV3 Job using greedy sampling, model-configured EOS tokens and a 768-token output limit.

The nine jobs are enqueued together and iterated until none remain. Results are printed alongside selected reference answers rather than scored automatically, making this a manual comparison tool rather than a quantitative benchmark.

impact.text: The intended command-line entry point is blocked before argument parsing: it passes default_cache_size=65536 to a helper that accepts only parser and cache.

source_notes.text: The script itself acknowledges possible familiarity with the source stories through a TODO requesting unfamiliar original material.

limitations: No model inference or GPU execution was performed; tokenizer compatibility, context fit and generated-answer quality remain unverified.
The reference summaries and character list were inspected, but the full story fixtures and their edits were not audited for accuracy.

claims.text: The script resolves eight fixture files relative to its own eval_texts directory, avoiding dependence on the working directory. Reference summaries and the character list are displayed after inference, not included in the corresponding prompts.

The requested 65536 value is a cache-token capacity, not a measured story length or accuracy threshold: model_init.init forwards args.cache_size as Cache.max_num_tokens. The existing parser helper instead supplies an 8192-token default and offers no default_cache_size parameter.
Executing the unchanged parent add_args function extracted by AST, with the new entry point's keyword argument, produced TypeError: add_args() got an unexpected keyword argument 'default_cache_size'.

findings.description: The new command-line entry point calls model_init.add_args with an unsupported keyword.
findings.trigger: Run eval/longctx.py as a script, assuming imports succeed.
findings.expected_behavior: Register command-line arguments with a 65536-token cache default, then parse arguments and start evaluation.
findings.actual_behavior: Argument registration raises TypeError before parse_args or main executes. This affects the direct script entry point, not a caller invoking main with an already constructed namespace. Whole-parent search found no longctx references.

verification.description: Compiled and executed the parent repository's actual add_args AST node with argparse supplied, then called it with the new keyword.
verification.limits: Isolated helper execution only; the complete script, package imports and model loading were not run.

annotation.summary: Adds nine manually inspected long-context tasks, but an unsupported cache-default keyword prevents normal command-line startup.
